body:
Hi,
and thank you for sharing your work.

Is there a tutorial on how to write a custom sensorsim environment starting from the protobuf definitions? The overall design seems to allow for a custom container, but I couldn't find any example for creating a new sensorsim specifically.

Thanks!

comments.body:
No, there unfortunately isn't a tutorial yet. We're working on making this easier by simplifying the API, but we're not there yet. 

But yes, one can swap the container out - this was one of the design goals of AlpaSim. I assume you already have a renderer that you'd want to use?

+1 to what Max said. Also, this might be a good starting point:
https://github.com/NVlabs/alpasim/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md#custom-container-images

Closing for now. Also see #56 as one step towards making integration of other renderers easier.
That MR unifieds the data interface of AlpaSim.

title: Custom sensorsim environment
